subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When the gate runs at planning entry, it shall verify that every live **Must** requirement of the PRD is served by at least one live design, failing with an **inverse-coverage** defect naming each unserved Must.
rationale: the feature-level "complete enough to plan" bar that has no owner today (`#F-6`, `#F-7`)
fit_criterion: a fixture with an unserved Must yields an `incomplete` verdict naming it; a fully-served fixture passes; the check consumes the existing coverage join, not a fork
